verdict.rationale: Workable documents its own token-authenticated REST API (v3) that offers 'full control over your data'. It can be called from a terminal with scoped tokens for scripted jobs such as bulk candidate migration, which supports non-interactive automation of the SaaS. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI integration, or a safe test environment, and the docs steer integrators to test against their live account. missing for 10: official CLI or CI-specific guidance, test/sandbox tenant or test keys, published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API changelog/versioning policy, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
